name: hub-docker
description: Docker Hub (hub.docker.com), the public container image registry. This CLI searches images by category, lists tags and image layers, reads repository, publisher and organization info, browses the Docker MCP server catalog, and fetches Docker Scout vulnerability summaries.

commands.name: list-categories
commands.summary: List Docker Hub image categories. Their slugs are the --category values for search-category-images.

commands.name: search-category-images
commands.summary: Search repositories within one category by keyword, with filters for product type and trust badge, a sort order and page number.

params.name: category
params.description: Category slug from list-categories, e.g. databases-and-storage, web-servers

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort key. Omit for best match.

commands.name: get-official-image
commands.summary: Get details of a Docker Official Image (library/*), such as nginx: description, categories, pull count, stars, last updated date and full overview (full_description).

params.name: image
params.description: Official image name without namespace, e.g. nginx, postgres, alpine

commands.name: list-official-image-tags
commands.summary: List the tags of a Docker Official Image, with a name filter, sort order and page number. Includes the tag digest, size, last update and per-architecture images (architecture, os, digest, size).

params.name: tag_name
params.description: Only tags whose name contains this text, e.g. alpine

params.name: ordering
params.description: Sort order: name / -name (alphabetical) or last_updated / -last_updated (by recency). Omit for newest first.

commands.name: get-repository
commands.summary: Get details of a community or verified-publisher repository such as grafana/grafana: description, pull count, stars, categories, last updated date and full overview (full_description).

params.name: namespace
params.description: Repository owner (user or org), e.g. grafana

commands.name: list-repository-tags
commands.summary: List the tags of a non-official repository (namespace/repo), with a name filter, sort order and page number. Includes digest, size, last update and per-architecture images.

params.name: tag_name
params.description: Only tags whose name contains this text

commands.name: get-image-layers
commands.summary: Get details of one tag's image: per-architecture digests, sizes, last pulled date and the Dockerfile layer commands.

params.name: digest
params.description: Image digest with a dash instead of a colon: sha256-<hex>. Take it from the tag list (sha256:<hex>) and replace ':' with '-'.

commands.name: get-image-vulnerabilities
commands.summary: Get the Docker Scout vulnerability counts (critical/high/medium/low/unspecified/total) and SBOM state for an image digest.

params.name: repoName
params.description: Repository name as Scout knows it: bare name for official images (nginx), namespace/repo otherwise

bodyTemplate.query:
query imageSummariesByDigest($context: Context!, $digests: [String!]!, $repository: ScRepositoryInput) {imageSummariesByDigest(context: $context,
digests: $digests,
repository: $repository)  {digest
sbomState
vulnerabilityReport  {critical
high
medium
low
unspecified
total}}}

commands.name: get-organization
commands.summary: Get public info for a Docker Hub organization or namespace: full name, company, location, website, join date and verified-publisher badge.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Org name, e.g. grafana, or library for Docker Official Images

commands.name: list-publisher-repositories
commands.summary: List the public repositories a publisher or user owns, with a name search, sort order and page number.

params.name: search
params.description: Filter repositories whose name contains this text

commands.name: search-mcp-servers
commands.summary: Search the Docker MCP Catalog of containerized MCP servers by keyword, optionally filtered by category.

params.name: categories
params.description: Catalog category filter, using the category value shown in the explore page

commands.name: get-mcp-server
commands.summary: Get details of an MCP catalog server: description, image, source repo, readme/tools URLs and config.

params.name: id
params.description: MCP server id from search-mcp-servers, e.g. github-official

commands.name: list-mcp-server-tools
commands.summary: List the tools an MCP catalog server exposes, with their names and descriptions.

notes: *.data endpoints are Remix single-fetch (turbo-stream) responses. They come back as one flat JSON array, not nested objects. Objects appear as {"_K": V}: K is the array index of the key-name string and V is the array index of the value. Negative numbers are sentinels: -5 means undefined and -7 means null. To read a value, follow the indices. Strings such as descriptions, tag names, digests and pull counts appear inline right after their key names, so scanning the array is often enough.
Global search (/search?q=) is behind a Cloudflare bot check. Use search-category-images (call list-categories first for the slugs) or list-publisher-repositories instead.
Official images use the 'library' namespace: /_/{image} on the site, and namespace=library for get-image-layers and get-organization. In Scout, repoName is the bare name (nginx).
Digest format differs by command: the tag list and Scout use sha256:<hex>, while get-image-layers needs sha256-<hex> (colon replaced by a dash).
The Scout GraphQL repoFeatures query returns 403 when not logged in. Whether imageSummariesByDigest works anonymously was not confirmed: only the repoFeatures 403 response was captured.
Sort values 'updated_at' and the badges/type values other than 'verified_publisher'/'image' come from the UI options; only pull_count, verified_publisher and image were confirmed in the recording.

list-repository-tags, get-official-image and get-repository use the matching Remix .data routes for pages that were recorded as HTML documents (/r/grafana/grafana, /_/nginx). Those exact .data URLs were not captured.
